name: UK weather warnings
summary: Yellow fog warnings across England, Wales and Northern Ireland; no amber or red warnings
state: The Met Office had nine yellow fog warnings in force at 05:40 UTC on 9 Nov, covering most English regions, Wales and Northern Ireland, and no amber or red warnings (Met Office). Fog warnings are short-lived and mainly affect travel, so Normal is kept despite the spread.
for_you: Drivers in the warned areas may meet slower journeys and reduced visibility. The Met Office publishes current warnings and advice for travel in fog.
why: Met Office warnings are the official signal for disruption to travel, power and safety in the UK.
drivers: Storms, heavy rain, snow and ice, heat, fog, thunderstorms.

rubric.watch: Widespread yellow or any amber warning in force.
rubric.normal: No warnings, or only localised yellow warnings.
